units.source_text: 这时候，名人对局势似乎还抱有希望。

en.t: At this point, the Master still seemed to have some hope about the position.

units.source_text: 下完棋之后，名人对《东京日日新闻》的五井记者和我冷不防地流露了这么一句：

en.t: After the game was over, the Master suddenly let slip these words to Goi, the reporter from the Tokyo Nichinichi Shimbun, and to me:
